short: The explicit gain at a prime

lean.name: Formalism.MainNotions.G.gainP
lean.plain: The explicit gain at a prime
lean.note: The local gain vanishes above the prime cutoff and at inert primes with $h_p=0$. In the orbit sum, each orbit contributes $\max(g_0,0)$, with $g_U-\mathrm{Pr}$ also included in the maximum on the orbits in $VV$.

lean.name: Formalism.MainNotions.G.gainP
lean.plain: The explicit gain at a prime
lean.note: The linked definition supplies the local divisibility gain for each prime and lift in the compiled RH argument, by summing the gains over Frobenius orbits and returning zero in the excluded cases. The three namesakes mentioned here live in other namespaces and sit outside the final dependency cone.
